extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and institutional grants administrators preparing and submitting federal grant applications (NIH, CDC, FDA, AHRQ)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and mandatory instructions for preparing and submitting grant applications to NIH and partner agencies, including which instruction sets and system tools to use, required forms and attachments, submission policies, and procedural requirements for pre- and post-award actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use application instructions on this page plus funding opportunity guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the application instructions found on this page along with the guidance in the funding opportunity to submit grant applications to NIH, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the Food and Drug Administration, and the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This page is the authoritative landing for program-wide and activity-code-specific instructions; always cross-check the FOA for program-specific requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare and submit applications using an online system
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications must be prepared and submitted using an online system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the designated NIH systems (ASSIST, eRA Commons) and Grants.gov for application assembly and submission; paper submission is not accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Determine the correct application instructions for your activity code
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify and follow the instruction set that corresponds to the application's activity code (research, training, fellowship, career development, multi-project, SBIR/STTR, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selecting the wrong activity-code instruction set will lead to incorrect form usage or missing required components; use the page's tool/link to determine correct instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow form-by-form, field-by-field application instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the detailed, form-by-form and field-by-field instructions provided for completing each part of the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These instructions explain expected content, required fields, and formatting for each application form and attachment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the correct SF424 (R&R) form version
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the specified SF424 (R&R) form version (e.g., SF424 (R&R) - Version I for due dates on/after Jan. 25, 2025).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure you are using the current/appropriate SF424 version referenced on this page to match system validation and FOA requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to General Instructions (G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the 'General Instructions' guidance which provides comprehensive instructions that apply to all applications and program-specific call-out boxes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General Instructions include standard requirements that apply across activity codes and flag program-specific exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Research Instructions (R)
rubrics_metrics.description: For research activity codes (R, including Research Education R25, and equivalent Cooperative Agreements U), follow the Research Instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research-specific call-outs and expectations (e.g., research plan content) are provided in this instruction set.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Career Development Instructions (K)
rubrics_metrics.description: For individual career development activities (K), follow the Career Development Instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These instructions address eligibility, mentor plans, training plans, and other K-specific requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Training Instructions (T)
rubrics_metrics.description: For institutional training activity codes (T) and institutional career development codes (K12, KL2, KM1), follow the Training Instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers institutional training program elements, trainee appointment requirements, and related documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Fellowship Instructions (F)
rubrics_metrics.description: For fellowship activity codes (F), follow the Fellowship Instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes biographical sketch expectations for fellows, sponsor statements, and training plan content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Multi-Project Instructions (M)
rubrics_metrics.description: For program project grants and center grants (P) and equivalent Cooperative Agreements (U), follow the Multi-Project Instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses structure and content for multi-project applications, cores, and overall component linking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow SBIR/STTR Instructions (B)
rubrics_metrics.description: For SBIR/STTR activity codes (R41-R44, SB1, U43, U44, UB1, UT1, UT2), follow the SBIR/STTR Instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes small-business-specific requirements such as company eligibility, commercialization plan expectations, and budget constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use required format pages/templates for certain attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific templates (format pages) are required for a small number of application attachments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the 'Format Pages' link to download templates and ensure attachments use the required format; failure to use required templates can lead to non-compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Page Limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Adhere to page limits specified for application components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page limits vary by section and activity code; exceedance can result in truncated or non-compliant content — review the 'Page Limits' guidance carefully.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Rules for Text Fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Comply with formatting and content rules that apply to text fields in forms and attachments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules include allowed fonts, margins, embedded objects, and how content is captured by system validations; consult 'Rules for Text Fields' to avoid formatting validation errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format attachments per 'Format Attachments' guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare all attachments according to specified formatting rules and accepted file types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This includes allowed fonts, file formats, and naming conventions for attachments; improper formatting can trigger validation errors or rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include required personnel and site format pages
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the 'Additional Performance Site Format' and 'Additional Senior/Key Person Profile Format' where applicable to provide information on sites and key personnel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These specific format pages ensure consistent reporting of multi-site and personnel details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare and submit required forms: Biosketch, CPOS, Other Support, Data Management Plan, etc.
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete specified common forms such as Biographical Sketch (Fellowship and Non-Fellowship formats), Current and Pending (Other) Support (CPOS) Common Form, Other Support, Data Management and Sharing Plan Format Page, and relevant data tables.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided format pages, instructions, and samples for each form; failure to provide complete or correctly formatted support/biosketch information can affect eligibility and review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow instructions for reference letters
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the 'Instructions for Submission of a Reference Letter' when reference letters are required (e.g., some fellowship applications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference letters may have specific submission mechanisms, content expectations, and timing; ensure letter writers follow the guidance to be considered valid.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comply with Required Disclosures of Foreign Affiliations or Relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide required disclosures of foreign affiliations or relationships to foreign countries as instructed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete disclosure is required where applicable; see the listed format/page for specifics about what must be disclosed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Register and use systems: ASSIST, eRA Commons, Grants.gov
rubrics_metrics.description: Use specified systems: ASSIST to prepare applications, eRA Commons to exchange application information and for account management, and Grants.gov to find and apply for funding opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure organizational accounts (Signing Officials, AORs) and PI Commons accounts are valid and linked; watch for system notifications related to assembled application, errors, warnings, and tracking numbers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check completeness and respond to system validation notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Be aware of how NIH checks for completeness and how Grants.gov/eRA Commons send notifications (submission receipts, validation receipts, rejections, warnings/errors).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor emails and Commons for assembled application views, errors and warnings, and act promptly to correct issues or submit changed/corrected applications if permitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Submission Policies including late and resubmission rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Adhere to submission policies such as standard due dates, NIH late application submission policy, resubmission application policy, and continuous submission rules where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to meet submission policies can lead to administrative rejection; review 'Standard Due Dates' and historical policies (resubmission rules) as relevant to the FOA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Annotated Form Sets and Sample Applications to avoid common errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Consult annotated form sets (visual references) and sample applications and documents to understand expected content and common pitfalls.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annotated sets illustrate form fields and include tips to avoid common errors; sample applications show exemplars of successful formatting and content organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comply with NIH Grants Policy Statement terms and conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Understand and comply with the NIH Grants Policy Statement, which outlines policy requirements that serve as the terms and conditions of NIH grant awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policy compliance is mandatory post-award; applicants should be familiar with these conditions as they affect administration and reporting if funded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow procedures for changed/corrected, withdrawn, and late applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the provided procedures for submitting changed/corrected applications, withdrawing an application, or addressing late submission situations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There are defined processes and timelines for corrections and withdrawals; consult the page sections on how to submit a changed/corrected application, withdraw your application, and NIH late application policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respond to Just-in-Time (JIT) requests and manage post-award steps
rubrics_metrics.description: If requested, provide Just-in-Time (JIT) information and follow procedures for Notice of Award (NOA), accepting the award, monitoring, reporting (RPPR), audits, and closeout.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare to supply documentation JIT requests ask for and to meet post-award reporting and compliance obligations described on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use 'Find Your Opportunity, Contacts, and Due Dates' resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Locate the appropriate funding opportunity announcement (FOA), identify program and grants management contacts, and confirm submission due dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section VII of each FOA provides submission and contact details; contact your institutional sponsored programs office first for questions, then NIH contacts if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be aware of additional required certifications and institutional forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain applications require additional institutional certifications and forms such as Annual Payback Activities Certification (APAC), Payback Agreement, SBIR/STTR certifications, Statement of Appointment, Termination Notice, and others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify and include any activity-specific institutional certifications per the instruction set for your activity code and FOA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow data-related requirements (Data Management and Sharing Plan; Data Tables)
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a Data Management and Sharing Plan and any required data tables following the specified format pages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data sharing expectations and required table formats vary by activity and FOA; use the provided format page and follow NIH data policies.
